svg.text: Algo trading system: full flow, v5
Proposed Design. Solid arrows are the trade path. Dashed red is feedback and kill switch. Dashed purple is approved-model handoff.
Research validation: inputs to backtest and risk, no trade path
Market inputs: flow, relative strength, microstructure, filings
Support and model health: always on, no direct trade path
Corp actions, stale and missing bars
NSE, BSE, SEBI parsed to events
Values as known on each date
Carry rules by gap and liquidity
Fat finger, lot, OPS, algo ID
Small items not drawn as blocks
1. Corporate-action order: splits, bonuses, dividends, demergers
3. Trading calendar: NSE/BSE holidays, muhurat session
5. Retry rules for the order state machine (idempotent)
6. Auto square-off retry if an order fails
7. Index circuit freeze and resume handling
8. Manual kill-switch button, plus automatic triggers
9. Session rules: pre-open, auction, closing orders
11. Scheduled reconciliation: broker vs OpenAlgo vs ledger
12. Stale-feed and missing-bar checks before signals
13. Broker-side algo registration and order tagging
15. Immutable audit log with secure storage
17. NTP clock sync for audit timestamps
18. Backup, disaster recovery, and failover plan
19. Change management and model sign-off record
20. Test suite run on every commit
21. Dashboard panels: profit factor, risk utilization
Blue engines and strategy bot: read-only inputs and the order-running framework. Each box feeds the lane named in its Flow stage line.
Blue engines not wrapped yet. Amber dashed: planned wrap next. Grey dashed: not in the flow yet or no decision. Full list in the flow doc, section 4.3.
